title: Freeze initial runtime and prompt split
description: Lock the first local environment, define the initial creative/uncreative prompt split, and record the exact configuration before claim-bearing runs.

title: Add generation-side creativity steering smoke
description: Use the selected pilot dense direction to run a first generation-side steering smoke on a small pilot subset. Save before/after generations plus exact steering settings so extraction-only results are not mistaken for behavioral replication.

title: Build complete local paper corpus from research docs
description: Expand the paper manifest from the current placeholder set to the full research-doc citation corpus, download full local artifacts, add an index for agents, and enforce coverage with tests.

title: Second-pass research-doc paper sweep
description: Add the remaining named papers from research/*.md to the local paper corpus, especially missing activation-steering, latent-reasoning, and evaluation references from the brainstorming docs.

title: Implement first creativity-direction replication slice
description: Run the smallest real Gemma 2 2B creativity-direction replication artifact on the frozen split and save the result under results/creativity_direction/.

title: Rereview scaffold against experiment docs and resattn
Resolve remaining doc-hierarchy and base-config drift
description: Fix the last alignment drifts by setting the 65K base SAE config, tightening the mission framing, and codifying the priority order across the research docs.

title: Control lexical template confound in creativity layer selection
description: The raw pilot layer sweep selected layer 0 with perfect pair separation, which is likely dominated by lexical differences between the creative and uncreative instruction templates. Add a control or revised selection procedure so early-layer prompt-template leakage is not mistaken for a creativity representation.

title: Final rigor audit and novelty alignment
description: Audit creativedecomp against resattn for structural rigor, tighten AGENTS coverage, and align the live strategy docs with experiment-novelty.md.

title: Compare signed creativity-direction decomposition methods on pilot slice
description: Implement and compare at least two signed decomposition methods for the dense creativity direction on the frozen pilot slice before any confirmatory decomposition run. The comparison should explicitly avoid naive dense-vector SAE encoding and save method notes and artifacts under results/feature_decomposition/.

title: Run pilot layer sweep for dense creativity direction
description: Evaluate the frozen pilot split across a bounded layer set so the dense creativity-direction layer is chosen by evidence rather than scaffold default. Save artifacts under results/creativity_direction/ and compare pairwise projection separation across layers.

title: Repair base-model story prompting for steering evaluation
description: The first generation-side smoke on Gemma 2 2B produced mostly prompt-meta continuations rather than clean story outputs. Design and validate a continuation-style or otherwise base-model-compatible prompting harness before interpreting steering-side creativity effects.
